title: Sonobudoyo Museum

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the south heritage gate approach.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Sonobudoyo Unit I site and standing roof polygons
mapIdentity.scope: Named Sonobudoyo Unit I OSM precinct, Wikidata Q4271636 and five mapped roof shapes establish the current location, separation and registered roof envelopes. The provincial listing describes the west wing, east gallery expansion and larger arts pavilion.

note: The provincial cultural register records a 3.25 m entrance gate, an open 16.25 by 12.40 m receiving pavilion, the narrow transition wing, a clay-tile main hall, a two-storey secretary wing and the eastern 20 by 21 m three-tier arts pavilion with a south entrance projection. The current public-domain Qualla photo shows the red tile, white piers and deep, sloped roof tiers behind the street frontage.
